name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
summary: Nat Pagle asks you to bring him four kinds of fish from distant shores and rivers. The catch spans the Swamp of Sorrows, Desolace, Feralas, and Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Four Waters
sections.body: Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh is waiting for four fish from across Azeroth. You are asked to bring him a Misty Reed Mahi Mahi, a Sar'theris Striker, a Feralas Ahi, and a Savage Coast Blue Sailfin. Each comes from a named shore or river, and Nat awaits your return with the full catch.

faq.q: Which fish does Nat Pagle want?
faq.answer: Nat Pagle asks for a Misty Reed Mahi Mahi, a Sar'theris Striker, a Feralas Ahi, and a Savage Coast Blue Sailfin.

faq.q: Where can I find the Misty Reed Mahi Mahi?
faq.answer: The Misty Reed Mahi Mahi comes from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Where is the Sar'theris Striker from?
faq.answer: The Sar'theris Striker comes from Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.

faq.q: Where can I find Feralas Ahi?
faq.answer: Feralas Ahi comes from the Verdantis River in Feralas.

faq.q: Where is Savage Coast Blue Sailfin found?
faq.answer: Savage Coast Blue Sailfin comes from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What should I do after catching the fish?
faq.answer: Return to Nat Pagle with all four fish.
